newsitem.title: USA: Capital Growth Holdings sets first div.
newsitem.headline: Capital Growth Holdings sets first div.

text.p: Capital Growth Holdings Ltd said Monday its board of directors declared a $0.225 annual per share dividend on shares of its common stock for each of 1997 and 1998.
The first dividend payment is slated for July 2 for shareholders of record June 30. After that, the dividend is anticipated to be paid quarterly.
Capital Growth Holdings Ltd develops diversified financial services pursuing world-wide business opportunities.
